# Sahara Atelier — Full context

Sahara is a single-brand e-commerce storefront. Products are listed on the home page; shoppers can search, view product details, add to cart, and request orders (cash on delivery). Merchants manage products, discounts, and orders via /admin.

## Key facts
- Money is stored as integer cents.
- Order statuses: placed → confirmed → fulfilled | cancelled.
- Authentication via Better Auth.
